popCulture.title: Hellen
popCulture.description: The mythological eponym of the Hellenes — Deucalion’s son from whom Dorus, Xuthus, and Aeolus branch — survives chiefly as a genealogical hinge rather than a painted subject.

popCulture.title: Bibliotheca (Hellen and his sons)
popCulture.creator: Apollodorus
popCulture.description: Apollodorus’ handbook fixes Hellen as the father of Dorus, Xuthus, and Aeolus — the stem from which the Dorians, Ionians, and Aeolians take their names.
